name: Cell Biology
summary: How cells are built and run: membranes, organelles, protein sorting, the cytoskeleton, communication, division and death.

topics.name: Cell theory, microscopy history and the prokaryote/eukaryote divide
Membrane structure: the fluid mosaic model and membrane proteins
The nucleus, nuclear envelope and nuclear pore transport
Endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus and the secretory pathway
Intracellular compartments and protein sorting signals
Vesicular traffic: endocytosis, exocytosis, coat proteins and SNAREs
Lysosomes, peroxisomes, autophagy and protein degradation
Mitochondria and chloroplasts: structure, genomes and endosymbiotic origin
The cytoskeleton: actin filaments, microtubules, intermediate filaments and motor proteins
Cell communication overview: signals, receptors and responses
The cell cycle, checkpoints and cyclin/CDK control
Mitosis, cytokinesis and the mechanics of cell division
Programmed cell death: apoptosis, necroptosis and their regulation
Cell junctions, cell adhesion and the extracellular matrix
Cells in tissues: polarity, differentiation and tissue renewal
